issues.description: Primary button labels are unreadable/truncated; Play, Settings, and Credits do not present live readable text as required.
Mobile button labels are also unreadable/truncated, with only fragments visible beside icons; this breaks the required readable live text on touch layouts.
The required Settings panel is not visible in the settings-state preview. Music toggle, volume slider, and close control are all missing from the shown state.
The required Credits panel is not visible in the credits-state preview. The small credits panel and its close control are missing from the shown state.
A large dark central slab sits behind the menu stack and reads as an accidental empty zone rather than a purposeful grouped surface.
Tablet preserves the same oversized empty background block behind a tiny control cluster, leaving too much dead space in the focal region.
The Play CTA is only slightly larger than secondary actions and loses dominance because the text is broken and the decorative title plate carries more visual weight.
The mobile layout behaves like a narrow shrink of desktop rather than a deliberate touch-first reflow; hierarchy, readable labels, and panel states are not maintained.
Icon treatment is not resolved consistently across peers: the generic info-style credits icon and mismatched line weights weaken the promised matching family.
The title plate side blocks look like blunt dark cutouts rather than ornamental endcaps, which makes the premium plate feel unfinished.
The title plate sits very close to the top ornament area and leaves cramped headroom compared with the unused lower half of the screen.
At gameplay scale the small fragmented labels and thin interior icon/text area would be hard to parse quickly, especially for younger players.

criticalIssues: Unreadable button typography on desktop and phone breaks the core menu interaction.
Settings-state preview does not show the required settings panel, toggle, slider, or close button.
Credits-state preview does not show the required credits panel and close button.
Mobile responsiveness is not successfully demonstrated; the touch layout does not preserve readable hierarchy or requested modal states.
repairInstructions: Restore fully readable live labels for Play, Settings, and Credits on every breakpoint; increase text area, reduce icon intrusion, and ensure no truncation or clipping.
Show the actual Settings modal in phone-settings with visible heading, music toggle, volume slider, and a touch-safe close button.
Show the actual Credits modal in phone-credits with visible compact body text and a touch-safe close button.
Strengthen the Play CTA so it is unmistakably primary through larger size, stronger contrast, and clearer separation from secondary buttons.
Replace the oversized empty dark dock slab with either a tighter content-bound grouping surface or remove it entirely so the center does not read as dead space.
Refine the mobile layout instead of uniformly shrinking desktop: rebalance top spacing, preserve larger readable labels, and keep controls thumb-friendly.
Unify the icon family across play, settings, credits, and close with matched weight, padding, and silhouette logic.
Keep the successful cyan/cobalt palette, restrained corners, and centered menu concept while repairing typography, hierarchy, and modal visibility.

preserve: Preserve the overall cyan/cobalt/navy palette with gold accents.
Preserve the centered title-plus-action-stack composition concept.
Preserve the restrained corner ornament placement and dark native background approach.
Preserve the same three requested main actions only: Play, Settings, Credits.
modify: Modify cmp_action_play, cmp_action_settings, and cmp_action_credits to enlarge label bounds, rebalance icon-to-text ratio, and guarantee readable live text on desktop, tablet, and phone.
Modify cmp_action_play to be visibly larger and more prominent than secondary peers.
Modify cmp_menu_dock so the background surface hugs the button group or becomes subtler, eliminating the dead central slab.
Modify cmp_title_plate end treatments to feel like intentional framed caps instead of flat dark blocks.
Modify mobile spacing for cmp_title_plate and cmp_menu_dock to create safer top breathing room and stronger touch-first hierarchy.
Modify the fallback icons in cmp_action_play, cmp_action_settings, cmp_action_credits, cmp_action_close_settings, and cmp_action_close_credits to share one coherent weight and style.
remove: Remove or substantially reduce the oversized empty rectangular backdrop behind the main buttons if it cannot be integrated into the grouping.
Remove any label clipping/truncation inside the three main buttons.
add: Add the visible cmp_settings_modal contents to the phone-settings state: heading, music toggle, volume slider, and close button.
Add the visible cmp_credits_modal contents to the phone-credits state: heading/body text and close button.
Add stronger spacing and width allocation for button text so labels remain fully readable at gameplay scale.
Add a clearer modal overlay presentation that visually supersedes the dimmed main menu when a panel state is active.
